s: Andhra Pradesh aims to become the maritime gateway of which part of India?

s: What is the annual capacity of the proposed Mazagon Dock merchant shipyard at Dugarajapatnam?
x: The shipyard's capacity is 1.2 million gross tonnes a year; MDL's investment is about ₹15,000 crore with about 45,000 jobs.

s: Maritime Amrit Kaal Vision 2047 aims to place India among the top how many shipbuilders of the world by 2047?
x: Maritime Amrit Kaal Vision 2047 aims for India to be among the top 5 shipbuilders by 2047, not the top 3.

s: Which statement correctly describes Visakhapatnam port in relation to Andhra Pradesh’s port network?
o: It is Andhra Pradesh’s only major port, with throughput of around 100 MTPA
It is Andhra Pradesh’s first greenfield OTMP, with throughput of around 200 MTPA
It is a state port in Prakasam district, with throughput of around 50 MTPA

s: What is Andhra Pradesh's rank in cargo handled by Other Than Major Ports (OTMPs)?
x: AP ranks second after Gujarat with 16% of OTMP cargo; OTMPs handle nearly 50% of India's port cargo.

s: NSHIP-AP, the SPV for the Dugarajapatnam shipyard, is owned equally by the AP Maritime Board and which other body?
x: NSHIP-AP is owned equally by the AP Maritime Board and the Visakhapatnam Port Authority.

s: Which company is developing the Kakinada Gateway Port?
x: Kakinada Gateway Port is an Aurobindo Group PPP project; Machilipatnam port is being built by MEIL.

s: How much cargo did Andhra Pradesh ports handle in 2025-26?
x: AP ports handled about 210 MMT; 91.17 MMT was Visakhapatnam port's, and 327.5 MMT is the combined capacity.

s: To what level does Andhra Pradesh plan to raise the cargo capacity of its OTMPs by the end of 2027?
x: Four greenfield OTMPs are to double OTMP capacity from 100 MTPA to 200 MTPA by the end of 2027.

s: How much is Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Ltd to invest in the merchant shipyard at Dugarajapatnam?
x: MDL will invest about ₹15,000 crore over 5-7 years; ₹29,254 crore is the feasibility cost of the whole shipyard.

s: Which Act provides for Major Port Authorities, such as the Visakhapatnam Port Authority?
x: Major ports come under the Union and are governed by the Major Port Authorities Act, 2021; non-major ports are under the States.

s: Which company set the 28.95 km bituminous-concrete road record on the NH-544G Greenfield Highway?

x: The record was set on NH-544G; bituminous concrete is bitumen with crushed stone aggregates forming the road's upper layer.

s: Where is the headquarters of the South Coast Railway zone, which began operations on 1 June 2026?
x: South Coast Railway, India's 18th zone, has its headquarters at Visakhapatnam.

s: Which of the following is NOT a division of the South Coast Railway zone?
x: SCoR's divisions are Guntakal, Guntur, Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam (renamed Waltair).

s: The Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport at Bhogapuram was built by GMR on which model?

s: In which district is the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport at Bhogapuram?

s: In which district did Raj Path Infrastructure lay 28.95 km of bituminous concrete road in 24 hours on NH-544G?
x: The Guinness record stretch started at Sadarlapalli, Puttaparthi constituency, Sri Sathya Sai district.

s: The NH-544G Greenfield Highway, where a Guinness World Record road was laid, is part of which expressway?
x: NH-544G is the Amaravati-Bengaluru Expressway greenfield highway.

s: South Coast Railway, headquartered at Visakhapatnam, is India's which railway zone?
x: SCoR began operations on 1 June 2026 as India's 18th railway zone.

s: On which date did PM Narendra Modi inaugurate the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport at Bhogapuram?
x: PM Modi inaugurated it on 1 August 2026; commercial operations began on 17 August 2026.

s: The Visakhapatnam division of the South Coast Railway zone was earlier known by which name?
x: The Waltair division was renamed Visakhapatnam division under SCoR, with HQ at Visakhapatnam.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Premier Energies' N-Type TOPCon solar cell facility?

Leadership State in Renewable Energy Investment Mobilisation
Leadership State in Green Hydrogen Manufacturing
Best State in Wind Turbine Production

97 projects, ₹1 lakh crore and 3.27 crore jobs

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about feeder-level solarisation under PM-KUSUM?

Under the CAPEX mode, a service company owns the project
Under the RESCO mode, a service company operates the project
The RESCO mode has a normal period of 25 years

Grid capacity, renewable integration, Distributed Energy Resources, Battery Energy Storage Systems and EV charging
Road construction, rooftop solar for houses, ambulances and welfare convergence

s: What type of project was Megha Engineering's cancelled 2,000 MW project at Kommuru in Annamayya district?

s: During the India–Denmark Energy Partnership visit to Amaravati, what project was discussed with APCRDA at its headquarters in Rayapudi?
o: Design of a 33-kV power grid for Amaravati
A digital twin of Amaravati at the Amaravati Integrated Command Control Centre
EV charging under the Amaravati power grid
A Research and Recommendation Paper for CM N. Chandrababu Naidu

s: Under the Andhra Pradesh Clean Energy Policy, which approved project is associated with M. Venkata Rao Infra Projects?

A 675 MW solar project at Madakasira in Sri Sathya Sai district
A 24 TPD CBG project at Midthur in Nandyal district
A 100 MW wind-solar hybrid project at Yemmiganur in Kurnool district

x: Green ammonia = green hydrogen + nitrogen taken from air.

Marine products, textiles, tea, coffee, petroleum, rice, coal and sugar

Organic chemicals, electronics, tea, rubber, rice, gold, chillies and coffee

x: Universities can conduct up to 80% of testing in-house with Q-SHIVA.

x: The centre is an AP partnership with IBM and TCS, using IBM superconducting quantum processors.

s: Where is the headquarters of IN-SPACe?

s: Through which canal did Andhra Pradesh release Godavari water to Uttarandhra?

s: The Polavaram Left Main Canal, carrying about 2 TMC per day to Uttarandhra, is planned to link the Godavari with which river?

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Krishna river-water sharing?

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Palle Panduga 3.0?
o: The Centre's share was ₹5,694 crore and the State's ₹5,391 crore
It was launched on 29 September 2026 at Udayagiri in Nellore district
Phase 1.0 included 4,000 km of cement roads and 22,514 cattle sheds
Phase 1.0 included 21,000 farm ponds and horticulture on 64,000 acres

s: What is the total outlay of Palle Panduga 3.0?

s: With reference to Andhra Pradesh tourism projects, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Suryalanka Beach – ₹77.91 crore; viewpoints and heritage walks

s: What is the approximate value of the eight Centre-funded tourism projects nearing completion in Andhra Pradesh?

Pilgrimage Renewal and Sacred Heritage Advancement Programme
Pilgrim Rejuvenation and Spiritual Heritage Development Drive
Pilgrimage Restoration and Sustainable Heritage Augmentation Scheme

A 7-year-old girl died and 23 people, including 15 children, fell ill
A 10-year-old boy died and 52 people, including 47 children, fell ill
A 7-year-old girl was injured and 52 people, including 47 children, were hospitalised

s: What is the scientific name of the Indian gaur?

s: The Valmiki Caves associated with Gooty are located near which of the following places and geographical features?
o: Gooty Fort on the Gooty–Mantralayam Road in the Erramala hills of Rayalaseema
Papikonda National Park along the Godavari in the northern Eastern Ghats
Pulicat Lake between Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu
x: The Valmiki Caves are near Gooty Fort on the Gooty–Mantralayam Road, in the Erramala hills of Rayalaseema. Papikonda, Pulicat Lake and Vaikuntham Queue Complex are different places associated with other events.

s:
Assertion (A): The Penukonda inscription belongs to the reign of Bukka Raya I.
Reason (R): The inscription is written in ancient Sanskrit.
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true

s: What kind of monsoons after the last Ice Age, around 11,700 years ago, do oxygen isotopes in the Valmiki Caves stalagmites indicate?
x: The stalagmite oxygen isotopes show stronger monsoons after the last Ice Age, around 11,700 years ago.

s: Which distinctive feature is associated with the Valmiki Caves near Gooty?
o: All cave formations are shaped like conical pillars
The caves contain only smooth granite walls
The caves have no stalactites or stalagmites
Some cave formations sound like a tabla or bell
x: Some formations in the Valmiki Caves sound like a tabla or bell, and the cave system contains stalactites and stalagmites. The statement that the caves have no stalactites or stalagmites is therefore incorrect.

s: With reference to the Vijayanagara-era inscription found at Penukonda, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Nagula Bavi – Place where the inscription was found
Anantharasu Chikka Odeyar – Prime Minister of Bukka Raya I
Sri Naga Lingeshwara Swamy Temple – Well of Serpents

s: Penukonda, where a Vijayanagara-era inscription with eight Naga Kanyas worshipping Shiva was found, was which capital of the Vijayanagara Empire?
x: Penukonda was the second capital of the Vijayanagara Empire.

s: What was the reported rescue operation in Papikonda National Park?

A 750-kg male Indian gaur was rescued from a wire snare in the Eco-Sensitive Zone
A female Indian gaur was rescued from a wire snare in Pulicat Lake
A 750-kg female Indian gaur was rescued from a wire snare in the Eco-Sensitive Zone
x: A 750-kg female Indian gaur was rescued from a wire snare in the Eco-Sensitive Zone of Papikonda National Park. It was found during patrolling in Indukuru Reserve Forest, while the Animal Rescue Centre in Visakhapatnam provided care; it was not the rescue location.

s: Where does Papikonda National Park lie?
o: Northern Eastern Ghats along the Godavari
Southern Eastern Ghats along the Krishna
x: Papikonda lies in the northern Eastern Ghats along the Godavari, not in the Western Ghats.

s: Which vector is associated with Plasmodium falciparum malaria in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Female Anopheles is the vector associated with Plasmodium falciparum.

x: The 10 new medical colleges come up under PPP from 2027-28.

s: Which of the following is NOT among the 10 new PPP medical colleges in Andhra Pradesh?

x: The caves are worshipped on Maha Shivaratri; their underground water bodies are Edu Bavulu and Gundalu.

s: In which script is the 1363 CE Penukonda inscription of Bukka Raya I's reign written?
x: The Penukonda inscription is in ancient Kannada-Telugu script, not Sanskrit.

s: Under which Schedule of the Wild Life (Protection) Act is the Indian gaur listed?
x: The Indian gaur (Bos gaurus) is in WPA Schedule I, IUCN Vulnerable and CITES Appendix I.

s: What is the IUCN status of the Indian gaur?
x: The Indian gaur is IUCN Vulnerable, WPA Schedule I and CITES Appendix I.

s: The hills of which National Park in Andhra Pradesh were historically called the 'Bison Hills'?
x: Papikonda NP, along the Godavari in the northern Eastern Ghats, has hills historically called the Bison Hills.

s: Which city is set to establish India's 1st Quantum Computing Valley by January 2026?

s: Which company's AI data centre project was approved in Andhra Pradesh with an investment of ₹87,520 crore?
x: Raiden Infotech India, a Google subsidiary, will build AI data centres with an investment of ₹87,520 crore.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the JSW Industrial Park and the SIPB?

s:

s: In which city was the CII Partnership Summit (14–15 November 2025), at which Sarla Aviation's Sky Factory was announced, held?

s: On 1 May 2025, at Narempeta in SPSR Nellore, foundation stones were laid for how many MSME parks?

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the MSME parks in Andhra Pradesh?

The Flatted Factory Complex is at Rambilli
The 'one entrepreneur in every household' vision targets 10 lakh jobs
The State plans 39 more MSME parks

s: Which of the following pairs on MSME development in Andhra Pradesh is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: MSME park mandate – at least one MSME park per district
One Family, One Entrepreneur – State scheme
CII flagship project – ‘Abhivruddhi Patham lo Swarna Andhra Pradesh Nuthana Prayanam’, backed by Volvo Group Trust

s: Among the SIPB-cleared tourism proposals, where is a luxury resort planned?
x: The proposals include four-star hotels in Amaravati and a luxury resort in Araku; Srisailam gets a three-star hotel and Kakinada a convention centre. (Sequence not possible: no dates.)

s: Who heads the 360° Global Capability Centres (GCC) Advisory Council constituted by Andhra Pradesh?
x: The council was constituted under HRD & IT Minister Nara Lokesh; NASSCOM, IIT Tirupati and USIBC are members or associates.

s: The Ratan Tata Innovation Hub envisages innovation centres in how many Assembly constituencies?
x: It plans innovation centres in all 175 Assembly constituencies; it was inaugurated on 21 August 2025.

s: With reference to the Ratan Tata Innovation Hub, which pair is correctly matched?
o: Partner – Infosys co-founder N.R. Narayana Murthy
Organisational model – Single hub at Visakhapatnam
Partner – Tata Sons Chairman N. Chandrasekaran
Organisational model – Hub-and-spoke, main hub at Visakhapatnam

s: Among projects announced at the Atmakur public meeting, which pair is correctly matched?
o: LG investment – ₹95,000 crore in Nellore district
x: Dagadarthi Airport is near Kavali; the BPCL refinery is ₹95,000 crore in Nellore district, LG's investment ₹5,000 crore with 10,000 jobs, and the engineering college is at Atmakur.

s: At the Atmakur public meeting, where was a new engineering college announced?

s: The 360° GCC Advisory Council of Andhra Pradesh has a roadmap of how many years?
x: The Council has a five-year roadmap.

s: As what does the Ratan Tata Innovation Hub seek to position Andhra Pradesh?
x: The Hub aims to make Andhra Pradesh the “Innovation Valley of India” and Amaravati a quantum computing hub.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Andhra Pradesh's sustainable tourism homestay initiative?
o: Vantamuru, Magada, Kuridi and Tajangi are tribal homestay locations in Araku Valley
The upgradation deadline for the homestays is September 2025
The urban homestay locations include Tirupati, Visakhapatnam and Vijayawada
Pasarlapudi, Malkipuram and Turupupalem are heritage homestay locations near Dindi in Konaseema
x: The upgradation deadline is August 2025, not September 2025.

s: Which of the following was among the upcoming initiatives announced by the Andhra Pradesh government?
x: Thalliki Vandanam was listed among upcoming initiatives, with farmer investment support, free education for orphans, WhatsApp governance and drone training.

s: Where were the CII Andhra Pradesh Entrepreneurs Development Forum and the CII Tirupati Entrepreneurs Development Forum launched?
x: MSME Minister Kondapalli Srinivas launched both forums in Tirupati. Narempeta, Atmakur mandal and SPSR Nellore were associated with the foundation-stone event for MSME parks, not the launch of these forums.

s: The 30th CII Partnership Summit at Visakhapatnam produced how many MoUs?
x: The summit yielded 610 MoUs worth ₹13.25 lakh crore and about 16 lakh jobs.

s: The AP Cabinet cleared SIPB projects worth how much, including Raiden Infotech's AI data centres?
x: The Cabinet cleared ₹1.27 lakh crore of SIPB projects, of which Raiden Infotech's data centres were ₹87,520 crore.

s: What was the total investment value of the 610 MoUs signed at the 30th CII Partnership Summit, Visakhapatnam?
x: The 30th CII Partnership Summit (14–15 Nov 2025) produced 610 MoUs worth ₹13.25 lakh crore.

s: Where is the ₹95,000 crore BPCL refinery, announced at the Atmakur public meeting, to be set up?
x: The BPCL refinery (₹95,000 crore) is in Nellore district.

s: Where was the Ratan Tata Innovation Hub inaugurated on 21 August 2025?
x: CM Naidu inaugurated it at Mayuri Tech Park, Mangalagiri, with Tata Sons Chairman N. Chandrasekaran.

s: Under Swarna Andhra@2047, Andhra Pradesh aims to become an economy of what size by 2047?
x: Swarna Andhra@2047 targets a $2.4-trillion economy by 2047 with 15%+ growth.

s: Google’s announced AI hub project in Andhra Pradesh involves an investment of how much over five years, and where will it be located?
x: Google's AI hub involves $15 billion over five years in Visakhapatnam, its largest investment in India. Its 480 acres are on two sites in Visakhapatnam district and one in Anakapalli; it is not in Amaravati or Bengaluru.

s:
Assertion (A): Google’s Visakhapatnam AI hub is its largest investment in India.
Reason (R): The project is an AI data centre in Visakhapatnam.
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true

s: Which of the following about Google's Visakhapatnam AI hub project is NOT correct?
o: It was cleared by the SIPB and the AP Cabinet.
Adani Group and Airtel are partners, including a new international subsea gateway.
It involves an investment of $15 billion over five years.
x: The implementing entity is Raiden Infotech India, a Google subsidiary; Airtel and Adani Group are partners.

s: Andhra Pradesh is targeting how much data-centre capacity by 2030?
x: The State targets 6,000 MW of data-centre capacity by 2030, with Sify Infinity's 550 MW expansion an anchor project.

s: Which organisation is included in the Cyber/resilience group of the Apex Data Centre Advisory Council?
x: CERT-In is included in the Council's Cyber/resilience group. IIM Visakhapatnam belongs to Academia, JLL to Industry, and IEEMA to Policy bodies.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Google's proposed AI hub in Andhra Pradesh?
o: The planned data centre has a capacity of 1 GW
The project moved from Andhra Pradesh to Karnataka
The investment is about ₹1.25 lakh crore
x: The project moved from Karnataka to Andhra Pradesh, triggering a tussle described as competitive federalism.

s: For Google's Visakhapatnam AI hub, water is to be supplied at what rate?
x: Water is supplied at 25% of cost for 10 years; power is free for 15 years.

s: The workshop held with the opening of the Data Science Centre at Tirupati marked which birth anniversary of C. R. Rao?
x: The workshop marked C. R. Rao's 105th birth anniversary, not the 100th.

s: On which fields does the Data Science Centre set up by the Tirupati chapter of ISPS focus?
o: Economics, Data Mining and Cloud Computing
Statistics, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
x: The centre focuses on Statistics, AI and Machine Learning, with interdisciplinary uses in fields like genetics and anthropology.

s: In which year is Jahnavi Dangeti's Titan Space Orbital Flight scheduled?
x: The flight is in 2029, after three years of training from 2026.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about AP's AI University plans?
o: India's first AI University is proposed in Amaravati.
It is proposed with LG AI Research.
The earlier NVIDIA MoU was for setting up the AI University.
It aims at a Korea–India AI Knowledge Corridor.

s: One objective of the proposed AI University in Amaravati is to set up which AI Knowledge Corridor?
x: The proposed corridor is Korea–India, not Korea–Japan.

s: With reference to LG AI Research, which pair is correctly matched?
o: Institutional role – Venture capital arm of LG Group
Mandate – AI research for 6 LG Group affiliates
x: LG AI Research is headquartered in Seoul; it was set up in December 2020 as LG Group's central AI think tank, doing AI research for 16 affiliates.

s: In AP's Apex Data Centre Advisory Council, which member represents the Industry group?
x: Microsoft Azure is in Industry; NASSCOM is in Policy bodies, Andhra University in Academia and CERT-In in Cyber/resilience.

s: Where is India's first Quantum Reference Facility (QRF) being set up?
x: India's first Quantum Reference Facility is at Amaravati Quantum Valley, with IBM Quantum India and TCS as strategic anchors.

s: What is the expected cost of India's first Quantum Reference Facility at Amaravati Quantum Valley?
x: The facility, for testing and benchmarking quantum hardware, is estimated at about ₹40 crore.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Quantum Reference Facility at Amaravati Quantum Valley?
o: The National Quantum Mission and DST are its strategic anchors
IBM Quantum India and TCS are its strategic anchors
Prof. R. Vijay Raghavan is the pioneer of India's first 6-qubit quantum computer
Prof. R. Vijay Raghavan is associated with TIFR
x: The National Quantum Mission and DST are partner institutions; IBM Quantum India and TCS are the strategic anchors.

s: The National Quantum Mission, associated with the Quantum Reference Facility initiative, has which timeline and processor target?
x: The National Quantum Mission covers 2023–2031 and targets 50–1000 qubit processors by 2031. The other options alter either the processor range, the starting year or the target year.

s: How was the IBM Quantum System approved for the Amaravati Quantum Computing Centre described?
x: The Cabinet decision described the IBM Quantum System at Amaravati as the first physical quantum computer in India.

s: Who announced the Amaravati Quantum Valley initiative in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Amaravati Quantum Valley was announced by Katamneni Bhaskar, Secretary, ITE&C, Andhra Pradesh. The other options are associated with different Andhra Pradesh news contexts, not the announcement of AQV.

s: Under IBM's Quantum Starling roadmap, linked to Amaravati Quantum Valley, by which year is a fault-tolerant quantum system planned?
x: IBM's Quantum Starling roadmap envisages logical-qubit computers and a fault-tolerant system by 2029.

s: Amaravati Quantum Valley, proposed for launch by January 2026, is described as India’s first what?
x: Amaravati Quantum Valley is described as India’s first Quantum Computing Valley, along with a tech park and research hub. A quantum secure communication network refers to the QNu project, while Quantum Starling is IBM’s roadmap and the Ratan Tata Innovation Hub is the skilling partner.

s: In 2022, Jahnavi Dangeti became the youngest Indian to complete the Analog Astronaut Programme at AATC. In which city is it located?
x: She completed the programme at AATC, Krakow, in 2022.

s: Amaravati Quantum Valley, India's first under the National Quantum Mission, is based on technology from which country?
x: It uses German technology, not Japanese, and its services begin in January 2027.

s: Google's AI hub project in Andhra Pradesh is aligned with the Digital Economy Vision of which year?
x: The project is aligned with Digital Economy Vision 2030 and the NITI Aayog National Strategy for AI.

s: Jahnavi Dangeti, who was selected as an astronaut candidate for the Titan Space mission, belongs to which place and district?
x: Jahnavi Dangeti is a 23-year-old from Palakollu in West Godavari district. Eluru is associated with para-swimmer Balaga Ganesh, while Jarjapupeta and Vijayawada relate to other Andhra Pradesh news items.

s: Jahnavi Dangeti of Palakollu is an Astronaut Candidate of which US-based company?
x: Jahnavi Dangeti is an Astronaut Candidate of Titan Space Industries for its 2029 orbital flight.

s: The National Policy on Electronics 2019 set a target of how much by 2025?
x: NPE 2019 set a $400 billion target by 2025.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Mangalagiri Gold Cluster Land Pooling Scheme?
o: It is at Atmakur village, Mangalagiri mandal.
It is under the APCRDA Act, 2014.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Mangalagiri Gold Cluster Land Pooling Scheme?

India's jewellery market is valued at about $80 billion
It includes a skill development centre
x: India's jewellery market is valued at about $100 billion, not $80 billion.

s: Racha Aribarg, who visited Sri City, is the Consul General in Chennai of which country?
x: Racha Aribarg is Consul General of the Royal Thai Consulate General, Chennai.

s: The visit of the Consul General of the Royal Thai Consulate General, Chennai, to Sri City was viewed in the context of which combination?

Act East Policy and Thailand as an ASEAN partner

s: Sri City lies on which industrial corridor?
x: Sri City, with SEZ, DTZ, FTWZ and EMC zones, lies on the Chennai–Bangalore Industrial Corridor.

s: Which of the following statements about the location and connectivity of Sri City is incorrect?
o: Sri City is approximately 70 km from Chennai railway station.
Sri City is connected by NH-16.
Sri City is linked to the Chennai–Vijayawada rail line.

s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?

s: How much did the Centre approve under the Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme for Syrma SGS's PCB plant at Naidupeta?

s: The Syrma SGS plant at Naidupeta is expected to become India's largest what?
x: Syrma SGS's Naidupeta project is to be India's largest integrated PCB and materials ecosystem.

s: Which company is setting up the integrated PCB and materials project at Naidupeta?

s: Where is Andhra Pradesh's Drone City located?

s: A Gold Cluster Land Pooling Scheme was notified in Andhra Pradesh through Rules framed in 2025 for which town?

s: Where is Syrma SGS Technology's integrated PCB plant, to be India's largest PCB and materials ecosystem?

s: The CESL tender under the PM e-Drive for 10,900 e-buses across five metro clusters was described as India's largest what?

s: Which of the following was included among the Andhra Pradesh cities identified for the first phase of the PM e-Bus Sewa programme?
x: The first-phase Andhra Pradesh cities were Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Rajahmundry, Nellore and Tirupati. Kakinada, Kadapa and Guntur were not included in the listed first-phase cities.

s: What is APSRTC's target for its bus fleet?
x: APSRTC aims at 100% fleet electrification; CESL is preparing an exclusive AP action plan.

s: The 'Adavi Thalli Baata' initiative targeted how many roads in remote tribal areas?
x: The initiative targeted 558 roads, with over ₹1,005 crore sanctioned in one year.

s: By which year does Andhra Pradesh's Sustainable Electric Mobility Policy 4.0 aim for carbon-neutral transport?
x: The policy targets carbon-neutral transport by 2047 and a global EV manufacturing hub.

s: On which date were the operational guidelines for Andhra Pradesh’s Sustainable Electric Mobility Policy 4.0 (2024–29) approved?
o: 10 April 2025, through the Integrated Clean Energy Policy 4.0
11 December 2024, through the Private Industrial Parks Policy 4.0

s: Where is Sarla Aviation’s proposed ‘Sky Factory’ electric air taxi hub located?
x: The Sky Factory is proposed in Anantapur district of Rayalaseema, in partnership with Bengaluru-based Sarla Aviation. Kurnool is associated with the proposed aviation MRO hub, while Amaravati and Vijayawada are associated with the Urban Water Metro project.

s: In which year is commercial manufacturing at Sarla Aviation's Sky Factory scheduled?

s: In the reclassification of gram panchayats in Andhra Pradesh, how many clusters were abolished?
x: 7,244 clusters were abolished; 13,351 is the number of independent panchayats created.

s: Which one of the following statements regarding Andhra Pradesh’s smart ration card rollout is incorrect?
o: The rollout was scheduled to be completed in all 26 districts by 30 September 2025.
The cards were launched by Civil Supplies Minister Nadendla Manohar in Vijayawada and Penamalur.
Beneficiaries can register grievances through village or ward secretariats and the toll-free helpline 1967.
Sub-ration depots were proposed for hilly and remote areas.
x: The incorrect statement changes the completion date to 30 September 2025; the rollout was to be completed in all 26 districts by 15 September 2025. The launch locations, grievance channels and proposal for sub-ration depots are correct.

s: Which policy was amended by the Andhra Pradesh Cabinet in the tourism sector?
o: Circular Economy and Waste Recycling Policy (2025–30)
PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan (2021)
x: The decision concerned amendments to the AP Tourism Land Allotment Policy (2024–29). The Circular Economy Policy and the AP Non-Agricultural Lands Act belong to different decisions, while the PM Gati Shakti plan is a national logistics initiative.

s: Under Navodayam 2.0, by which date was Andhra Pradesh directed to eliminate illicitly distilled liquor?
x: The deadline under Navodayam 2.0 was 30 September 2025 for eliminating illicitly distilled liquor in Andhra Pradesh. The other dates do not represent the announced deadline.

s: Under Andhra Pradesh's sustainable tourism initiative, the Chief Minister directed the preparation of which Homestay instrument?
x: The CM directed a Homestay Policy, not a Homestay Scheme; over 500 homestays were identified.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the inscription found near Dornala?
o: It records a well and sluice for temple lands.
x: 1518 CE falls in the 16th century, not the 15th.

s: According to the Dornala inscription, who built the well and sluice?
x: Velanga Parvata Nayani built them, with Kemidevuni Lingayya as the master.

s: With how many karma points did Challa Chandrasekhar Reddy top the iGOT Karmayogi test nationally?
x: He ranked first nationally with 5,001 karma points.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the proposed reorganisation of Andhra Pradesh districts?
o: It proposes expanding the State from 26 to 32 districts
Final approval and notification are expected in January 2026
The proposal identifies five new districts
Ongole is to remain the headquarters of Prakasam district
x: The proposal identifies six new districts, not five.

s: Under the proposed reorganisation of Andhra Pradesh districts, which new district is to be carved out of Prakasam?
x: A new Markapuram district is to be carved out, while Prakasam retains Kandukur and Addanki.

s: Andhra Pradesh's smart ration cards cover approximately how many beneficiaries?
x: The cards cover about 4.42 crore beneficiaries and work at any of the 29,000 fair price shops.

s: Under Navodayam 2.0, which of the following was identified as a high-ID district?
x: Kakinada was among the high-ID districts; Kurnool, Anantapur and Nandyal were border districts under NDPL watch.

s: Smart street vending markets in seven AP cities are being developed by MEPMA under which component?
o: Employment through Skills Training and Placement
Support to Urban Street Vendors (SUSV) under DAY-NULM
x: The markets fall under the Support to Urban Street Vendors (SUSV) component of DAY-NULM, implemented by MEPMA, not PM SVANidhi.

s: Which of the following about the Andhra Pradesh Cabinet's decisions on laws is NOT correct?
o: The old 1950s Manual Scavenging Prohibition Act was repealed.
The AP Beggary Prohibition Act was amended to remove language against persons with disabilities.
The 2013 Manual Scavengers Act was also repealed.
The old law had been superseded by the 2013 Act.
x: Only the old 1950s Act was repealed; the 2013 Act was not.

s: Which set of cities was selected for the development of smart street vending markets in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Anantapur, Kurnool, Tadepalli-Mangalagiri, Ongole, Srikakulam, Vijayawada and Kadapa
Anantapur, Nellore, Tadepalli-Mangalagiri, Ongole, Srikakulam, Vijayawada and Kadapa

Anantapur, Kurnool, Tadepalli-Mangalagiri, Guntur, Srikakulam, Vijayawada and Kadapa
x: The seven cities are Anantapur, Kurnool, Tadepalli-Mangalagiri, Ongole, Srikakulam, Vijayawada and Kadapa. The other options replace one of these cities with Nellore, Tirupati or Guntur.

s: After the Andhra Pradesh Cabinet decision, after whom was the Official Language Commission renamed?
x: It was renamed after Mandali Venkata Krishna Rao, freedom fighter and language activist.

s: Which law did the AP Cabinet repeal in its decisions on old laws?
o: Manual Scavenging Prohibition Act of the 1950s
x: Only the 1950s Manual Scavenging Prohibition Act was repealed; the 2013 Act stays and the Beggary Act was amended.

s: Who launched AP's smart ration cards covering about 4.42 crore beneficiaries?
x: Civil Supplies Minister Nadendla Manohar launched the smart ration cards.

x: The Telugu inscription records works for the lands of Mallikarjuna Deva at Sriparvata (Srisailam).

x: Tennis player Saketh Sai Myneni was made a Deputy Collector under the sports quota.

25 projects involving ₹2.01 lakh crore and 16 lakh jobs

s: The 31st CII Partnership Summit is scheduled to be held at which place and on which dates?

s: Over 23 months, how many projects worth ₹21.64 lakh crore were reported in Andhra Pradesh?
x: A total of 756 projects worth ₹21.64 lakh crore were reported over 23 months.

s: What is the approximate investment potential assessed for the Visakhapatnam Economic Region alone?
x: The Visakhapatnam Economic Region alone was reported to have an investment potential of ₹9.5 lakh crore.

s: Who led Andhra Pradesh's Korea roadshow in July 2026 ahead of the 31st CII Partnership Summit?
x: Nara Lokesh led the Korea roadshow in July 2026 before the 31st CII Summit at Visakhapatnam.

s: According to the Chief Minister (15 August 2026), about how much do the investment proposals received by Andhra Pradesh total?
x: The CM put proposals at ₹24 lakh crore, with ₹14 lakh crore approved and 11 lakh jobs.

s: Who said Andhra Pradesh aims to be the 'Saudi Arabia of clean energy'?
x: Nara Lokesh said AP aims to be the 'Saudi Arabia of clean energy'.

s: The $625 million loan for the Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor (VCIC) comes from which institution?
x: The VCIC is funded by the Asian Development Bank ($625 million of $840 million), not the World Bank.

x: The Kopparthy mega industrial hub is in YSR Kadapa district and covers 3,155 acres.

s: On which sector is the proposed Kopparthy industrial cluster primarily focused?
x: Kopparthy is proposed to become an electronics cluster.

s: Which of the following is associated with the Krishnapatnam node of CBIC?
x: The Krishnapatnam node of CBIC is in SPSR Nellore and covers 13,919.67 acres.

s: Land for which VCIC node was acquired in March 2026?
x: The Nakkapalli node of the VCIC had its land acquired in March 2026; Krishnapatnam is a CBIC node.

s: Which are the nodes of the Visakhapatnam–Chennai Industrial Corridor (VCIC)?
x: VCIC nodes are Visakhapatnam, Chittoor and Kopparthy (33,000 acres); Krishnapatnam is a CBIC node.

s: Suzlon's wind projects at Hulikera, whose foundation stone was laid on 25 August 2026, are in which district?
x: Hulikera is in Anantapur district; the APPSC 2025 key also gave Anantapur as the wind project partnership district. Kurnool has the 1,200 MW pumped hydro, Kadapa the Adani PSP, and Prakasam an RE zone under BHAVYA.

o: 400 MW solar at Kanekallu and 800 MW wind at Pathikonda

400 MW solar at Pathikonda and 400 MW wind at Kanekallu
800 MW wind at Hulikera and 400 MW solar at Pudimadaka

s: A pumped-hydro storage project of 1,200 MW was reported in which district in January 2026?
x: A 1,200-MW pumped-hydro storage project was reported in Kurnool in January 2026.

s: What does the thermal power project approved under the DBFOO model consist of?
x: The DBFOO thermal project consists of two 800-MW units, giving a total capacity of 1,600 MW, with an estimated cost of up to ₹25,000 crore.

s: How much renewable-energy capacity was allocated in Andhra Pradesh in June 2026?
x: Renewable-energy projects totalling 112.45 GW were allocated in June 2026.

s: Which of the following project – district pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Suzlon wind projects at Hulikera – Anantapur
x: The BHAVYA renewable-energy zone is in Prakasam; the other pairs are correct.

s: Yamanko India's green hydrogen project worth ₹9,398 crore is located in which district?
x: Yamanko India's ₹9,398 crore green hydrogen project is in Tirupati district.

s: How many PM Surya Ghar rooftop solar systems had Andhra Pradesh installed by August 2026?
x: AP had 4.11 lakh PM Surya Ghar systems, placing it in the top 4; 50,000 refers to APSPDCL rooftop connections.

x: Both are correct: Adani's PSP is in Kadapa and a 1,344 MW project is under study.

x: The RDSS was launched in 2021 with an indicated outlay of ₹3.03 lakh crore.

x: About ₹10,000 crore went to rural power networks; ₹522 crore was for Godavari Pushkaralu loss-reduction works.

x: Phase 3 of AP FiberNet is intended to provide broadband to more than 4,000 tribal hamlets.

s: What is the investment in Google's AI hub at Visakhapatnam?
x: Google's $15 billion AI hub (2026-2030) is its largest facility outside the US.

x: Adani (data-centre venture) and Bharti Airtel are the partners.

s: Where is the IIFT campus in Andhra Pradesh, whose Phase 2 was cleared?
